episodes.title: karte 1 「僕は奪われた」
episodes.summary: At first glance, he's just the disturbed boy, and she's just the popular girl. But people are more than the sum of their parts, as both Kyotaro and Anna are about to discover.

episodes.title: karte 2 「僕は死んだ」
episodes.summary: Despite his misgivings, Kyotaro keeps helping Anna the more they interact. He may be a better person than he believes.

episodes.title: karte 3 「僕は抱きしめたい」
episodes.summary: Anna and her friends keep their guard up around the boys; it's obvious what they want. But Kyotaro's different. Each brief interaction brings him and Anna closer together.

episodes.title: karte 4 「僕は心の病」
episodes.summary: Like many people his own age, Kyotaro has a tendency to overthink everything. Anna, however? She has her own way of approaching life.

episodes.title: karte 5 「僕らははぐれた」
episodes.summary: It's not like Kyotaro wants to join Anna's group or anything. But when a certain other classmate tries to join the group, Kyotaro just gets swept up in events. That's all!

episodes.title: karte 6 「僕は溶かした」
episodes.summary: As Kyotaro wrestles with his feelings, he notices Anna's been acting differently. Could it be that she— ? No, he shouldn't read too much into it. She's just being nice. Right?

episodes.title: karte 7 「僕らは入れ替わってる」
episodes.summary: Kyotaro can no longer deny he likes Anna. He tells himself it's not like he wants to be her boyfriend, but there's a detail he hasn't considered: maybe Anna wants him to be.

episodes.title: karte 8 「僕は夢を見た」
episodes.summary: Parent-teacher day mortifies Kyotaro. Not only is his mother at school, but she's bonding with Anna! Things couldn't get any worse.

episodes.title: karte 9 「僕は山田が嫌い」
episodes.summary: Despite all the hints Anna throws at him, and others beginning to notice, Kyotaro refuses to believe that she could actually like him. He is his own worst enemy.

episodes.title: karte 10 「僕らはゆっくり歩いた」
episodes.summary: It's Japan's most romantic time of the year and Kyotaro and Anna are not-on-a-date. Kyotaro is keeping a running tally of all his screw ups, but Anna is enjoying herself.

episodes.title: karte 11 「僕らは少し似ている」
episodes.summary: Distance separates Kyotaro and Anna, but their thoughts are of each other. However, their budding relationship faces a threat: Haruya still has his eyes set on Anna.

episodes.title: karte 12 「僕は僕を知ってほしい」
episodes.summary: Kyotaro didn't think his cunning plan for New Year's all the way through. Anna showed up early and now his sister is trying to be his wingwoman.

episodes.title: karte 13 「僕らは探している」
episodes.summary: Anna wants to help Kyotaro since he has a broken arm, but she's unaware of the secret he's keeping from her.

episodes.title: karte 14 「僕は大人のなりかけ」
episodes.summary: It's the first time Kyotaro has ever been in Anna's home, so he's naturally left feeling like a bundle of nerves and anxiety.

episodes.title: karte 15 「僕は山田と」
episodes.summary: Valentine's Day is a week away, and Kyotaru finds himself roped into making chocolates with Anna and her friends. But complications arise when Moeko claims Kyotaru as her bae.

episodes.title: karte 16 「山田は僕を」
episodes.summary: Valentine's Day chocolates hold a special meaning, and Anna wants to know what they mean to Kyotaru.

episodes.title: karte 17 「僕は知りたい」
episodes.summary: Despite all the time Kyotaru has spent with Anna, he discovers that there is so much more he doesn't know about her. More importantly, he realizes he wants to change that.

episodes.title: karte 18 「山田は僕が好き」
episodes.summary: As the student rep, Kyotaru faces the unenviable task of delivering the graduation speech. Now he'll need a dose of confidence and a little help from Anna to pull it off.

episodes.title: karte 19 「僕らは溢れ出る」
episodes.summary: The implications and meanings of Anna's indirect confession leaves Kyotaru reeling. He may not know what will happen next, but he knows he cannot afford to mess this up.

episodes.title: karte 20 「僕らは夜更かしした」
episodes.summary: The school year is ending. With a window of opportunity closing, Kyotaru reaches a decision: if he can make this shot in a basketball game against Anna, he'll ask her out.

episodes.title: karte 21 「僕らは約束した」
episodes.summary: Kyotaru discovers an obsessed fan is spreading rumors online that Anna has a boyfriend. Knowing what that means for both her safety and career, he cannot help but worry.

episodes.title: karte 22 「僕は山田に近づきたい」
episodes.summary: A new school year means a new class and new friends. Unfortunately, it also means new challenges to Kyotaru and Anna's evolving situationship.

episodes.title: karte 23 「僕は負けたくない」
episodes.summary: Kyotaru wants nothing to do with the sports festival this year, but all that changes when Sho challenges him to a one-on-one in the cavalry battle.

episodes.title: karte 24 「僕は伝えたい」
episodes.summary: The class is excited for the upcoming school trip, except for Anna, who is no longer acting like herself. Kyotaru wonders what it means, not realizing that she made a choice.

episodes.title: karte 25 「僕と私の恋心」
episodes.summary: Anna and Kyotaru's bond is teetering between friendship and romance. Perhaps this time the scales will tip and Kyotaru can finally tell Anna the words she wishes to hear.
